lines.text: It’s project time! Make an interactive story with at least two characters and two scenes.
Make a story with at least two characters and two scenes.
Ask the reader at least one question, and let their answer change the story.
Draw a story map: boxes for scenes and arrows for choices.
Each arrow is labelled with an answer.
Use broadcasts to start scenes and pass turns.
A branching story has more than one ending, so test each one.
Ask a friend to try answers you didn’t expect!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
